description: Get keyword bids. Common FieldNames: KeywordId, AdGroupId, CampaignId, Bid, ContextBid, CurrentSearchPrice, MinSearchPrice, StrategyPriority. Use when the user wants the current search or network bid for keywords. Do not use it to change a bid; call set_keyword_bids, which spends money and requires confirm. Do not use it for bid modifiers; call get_bid_modifiers.

field_names.description: Fields to return (FieldNames). See tool description for common values.

name: get_keyword_bids
